newsday_alternative.title: Congressional candidate Chris Gallant got fundraising boost after explicit pictures released, campaign filing shows
newsday_alternative.publisher: Newsday (alternative reporting; this is not proof it is the WLIW story or the WLIW article body)
newsday_alternative.visible_updated: October 17, 2026 7:01 am (timezone not stated in page display)
newsday_alternative.reported_facts: Newsday says Gallant raised about $930,000 since early July according to campaign-finance filings released that week; the campaign said $350,000 (38%) came in the two weeks after the photos were widely published. The article dates the photo publication to Sept. 13. These are Newsday-reported filing/campaign claims; this pass did not independently retrieve the filing or establish the precise two-week dates.
newsday_alternative.finding: Corroborates the underlying fundraising claim in a separate Newsday article published Oct. 17, before the WLIW alert timestamp. It does not verify WLIW article text, a new Oct. 19 fundraising event/filing, or an independent new poll.
